Name: Riolu Pet
Author: symagui
Description:
Riolu from Pokemon Mystery Dungeon found a new place to explore and live in, and it is your farm !

This mod adds a new pet with custom animations and noises that doesn't replace any of the vanilla pets.
You can choose to start with him when you create your farm, or get it later on once you unlocked the option to buy more pets from Marnie.

Also, if you get close enough with it, your riolu will gift you some of the items it finds on its adventures ! (all of its gifts are Pokemon Mystery Dungeon themed)

The Marnie adoption event will either be displayed in English (default) or French if you set it as your in-game language.


[b][size=3][u]Requirements and Installation[/u][/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod only works on Stardew Valley 1.6 and later.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Requires both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22631/]Hats On Pets Plus[/url] if you wish to give hats to Riolu
[/list]
[list]
[*]To install, unzip the file and place the folder within it ( [CP] Riolu ) into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
[/list]
